# yii3-idempotency-redis

## Install

```bash
composer require rasuvaeff/yii3-idempotency-redis
```

Requires `rasuvaeff/yii3-idempotency` ^2.2 and a Redis client: `ext-redis`
(PhpRedisScriptRunner) or `predis/predis` ^2.2 (PredisScriptRunner). Redis 2.6+
or any Valkey.

## Rules

- One backend next to the core: this package OR `rasuvaeff/yii3-idempotency-db`,
  never both — `yiisoft/config` fails on the duplicate `IdempotencyStorage` key
  by design.
- The application binds `IdempotencyScriptRunner` over its own client; the
  package binds only `IdempotencyStorage`.
- `claimTtlSeconds` must exceed the longest handler runtime: past it the key
  frees and a duplicate may re-run the effect.
- Ops: `maxmemory-policy noeviction` + AOF — an evicted or lost hash re-opens
  the key (duplicate execution).
- One HASH per key; body stored raw (Redis fields are binary-safe); the key's
  server-side TTL is the only expiry mechanism (no GC).

## API

### RedisIdempotencyStorage

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3IdempotencyRedis\RedisIdempotencyStorage;

$storage = new RedisIdempotencyStorage(
    runner: $runner,            // IdempotencyScriptRunner
    clock: $clock,              // psr/clock
    keyPrefix: 'idempotency:',  // non-empty
    claimTtlSeconds: 3600,      // >= 1
);
// implements IdempotencyStorage (load/claim/store/release),
// ClaimedFingerprintProvider (mid-flight 422 vs 409),
// ClaimedDeadlineProvider (Retry-After on the 409)
```

- `claim()` returns false when the key is taken (in-flight claim or stored
  record); generates a random 32-hex ownership token remembered per instance.
- `store()` writes only into the claim this instance took (token match) or
  into a free key; a fenced-out store is a silent loss by design.
- `release()` deletes only this instance's live claim; a release without a
  claim is a no-op.
- Throws `UnexpectedRedisReplyException` when a reply has an unreadable shape
  (the key space is written by something else).

### IdempotencyScriptRunner (interface)

```php
interface IdempotencyScriptRunner {
    public function run(string $script, array $keys, array $args): mixed;
}
```

### Runners

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3IdempotencyRedis\Redis\PhpRedisScriptRunner;   // ext-redis
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3IdempotencyRedis\Redis\PredisScriptRunner;     // predis

new PhpRedisScriptRunner(new \Redis());        // connected
new PredisScriptRunner($predisClient);
```

Both send EVALSHA first and fall back to EVAL on NOSCRIPT (loading the script
cache).

### Config

```php
// params
'rasuvaeff/yii3-idempotency-redis' => [
    'keyPrefix' => 'idempotency:',
    'claimTtlSeconds' => 3600,
],
// di: the app binds IdempotencyScriptRunner over its client;
// the package binds IdempotencyStorage => RedisIdempotencyStorage
```
